mapper.sql: id, item_id, spec_name, price, stock, sku_code, image, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pet_item_sku WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY price ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM pet_item_sku WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM pet_item_sku WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT stock FROM pet_item_sku WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_item_sku (item_id, spec_name, price, stock, sku_code, image, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{specName}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{skuCode}, #{image}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_item_sku SET spec_name = #{specName}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, sku_code = #{skuCode}, image = #{image}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_item_sku WHERE item_id = #{itemId}

SELECT s.id AS skuId, s.item_id AS itemId, i.title AS title, s.spec_name AS specName, s.sku_code AS skuCode, s.price AS price, s.stock AS stock, s.status AS skuStatus, i.status AS itemStatus, i.audit_status AS auditStatus, i.merchant_id AS merchantId FROM pet_item_sku s JOIN pet_item i ON i.id = s.item_id AND i.del_flag = '0'
AND (i.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND s.item_id = #{itemId} AND i.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND s.stock <= #{threshold}
ORDER BY s.stock ASC, s.id ASC

SELECT s.id AS skuId, s.item_id AS itemId, i.title AS title, s.spec_name AS specName, s.stock AS stock, s.sku_code AS skuCode FROM pet_item_sku s JOIN pet_item i ON i.id = s.item_id AND i.del_flag = '0' WHERE s.stock <= #{threshold} AND s.status = 1 AND i.status = 1 AND i.audit_status = 2 ORDER BY s.stock ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
